data.title: S4L14 — Zameer-e-Muttasil Mutakallim: بَيْتٌ ← بَيْتِي: Buniyadi Misaalein
data.caption: S4L14 — Zameer-e-Muttasil Mutakallim: بَيْتٌ ← بَيْتِي: Buniyadi Misaalein
rows: Mera ghar / Mera Rabb (Yaa se pehle Zair)
Meri namaz / Meri rahmat (Gol ة khul kar تِ ban gayi)
Meri laathi / Meri hidayat / Meri zindagi (Alif ke baad ـيَ)
Aye mere Rabb / Aye meri qom / Mera azaab (sirf Zer baaqi)

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 31–32):** Kisi bhi ism ke aakhir mein **`ـِي`** (Yaa-e-Mutakallim) lagane se **'Mera / Meri'** ka mafhoom paida hota hai (`بَيْتٌ ← بَيْتِي` mera ghar, `رَبٌّ ← رَبِّي` mera Rabb, `هَٰذَا رَبِّي` yeh mera Rabb hai). Agar lafz ke aakhir mein Alif ho toh Yaa par Zabar aata hai (`عَصَايَ`، `هُدَايَ`). Aur ba'az auqaat ikhtisaar ke liye Yaa gira kar sirf Zair baqi rakhi jati hai (`رَبِّ`، `يَا قَوْمِ`، `فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ`).

data.text: Kisi bhi ism (noun) ke aakhir mein Yaa-e Mutakallim (ي) laga dein toh uska matlab hoga 'mera / meri'. Jaise: بَيْتُ (ghar) + ي = بَيْتِي (mera ghar)
